what_changed: 12 CFR 1006.14(b)(2) now counts text messages toward the seven-in-seven presumption (diff: 'places a telephone call' -> 'places a telephone call or sends a text message'). New 12 CFR 1006.15 requires disclosure at the outset of a call that an artificial voice is used.
compliant_agent_must_now: From 2025-06-01, third-party collectors: count calls and texts together against the 7-in-7 cap per debt; disclose at the start of every call that the voice is artificial.
open_questions_for_deploying_team: Does the deployment act as a third-party collector or post-default servicer for any portfolio?
Register gap: add a Reg F row for 1006.15 AI-voice disclosure.
rationale: Final rule amending a tracked Reg F section with an eCFR diff showing the text change. Full-text excerpt confirms the effective date. The AI-disclosure section has no register row yet.
